chart_leg_findings: DECOMPOSE, and it is the one that cost the voyage its keeper defect. The split named a piece for the probe and NO piece for the probe's proof. So the watch was built, armed, emitted through the emission gate, and shipped raising AttributeError on its every-beat path — and no stage of the chain was ever going to ask for a tooth on it, because the tooth was not in the split. The emission gate proves berthed-and-armed; the split is where 'and it runs' had to be a piece, and was not.

TRIAGE. The order covered the split and the split was complete under its own rules, so nothing was dropped — and the exit gate still handed the voyage a body of unranked work: disposing probescan's 23/23 red took a measurable share of the 215 and appears in no rank. The standing reds a crossing will meet are knowable at triage time (probescan red 18/18 the day it was born) and the chain has no field that asks.

SURVEY. The refs never listed the crossing machinery the close runs on — TesterDevice.run_proof, persist_validation, clearance.clear, boat_owner_of — so each was opened cold at the close, and one of them cost a full refusal to learn: boat_id is the TICKET id, not the device id. That is arguable as out-of-bounds (survey scoped the build, not the close), and it is named rather than filed because the same four calls end every code-seam voyage and no survey has ever listed them.

for_akien: The per-beat trigger cost is 2531 ms and this build measured it rather than estimating it. This probe's own share is a median 2.1 ms (n=15, max 2.4) for the cheap half and 38 ms for the expensive half, which only runs when a bench actually stands. The 2531 ms belongs to the beat, not to this ticket, and is owed its own ticket.

Done here is THE LOOP NO LONGER BLAMES A DEVICE FOR ITS OWN AGE, not THE WATCH LAYER IS HEALTHY. The watch that answers the second question is now armed and, for the first time, proved to run. Its efficacy answer comes later, from the probe, against this ticket's falsifier.

Proven by the librarian, which probescan calls unable to receive while LibrarianShim returns a device with a callable receive. 22 of the 23 predate this build and it red 18 of 18 the day it was born. value.the_falsifier_answered_clause_by_clause: None of the seven RED clauses fired. (1) The condition was not constructed in a fixture and waved at — criterion 9 ran against the live daemon, and the first two attempts produced NO condition at all: moving probe.py, then move plus mtime bump, changed nothing, because sys.modules caches the dotted name and a re-exec'd probe rebinds the SAME class object. That diagnosis is part of the evidence, not a detour. (3) Neither face is special-cased by symbol name or error text; the predicate is a relation between a process start time and file mtimes, so a third face falls out of it too. (4) A probe from the affected folder reaches its consumer after detection — proved, not asserted. (5) The trouble is raised against the LOOP. (6) The bench-from-live-tickets rule at loop.py:50 is untouched. (7) The ruled 5s liveness threshold is untouched, which was Akien's one named bound.

value.the_watch_shipped_unproved_and_that_is_t: The probe was discovered, loaded, berthed, and emitted through the emission gate with the suite reading 107/107 green — and its every-beat path raised AttributeError: 'TroubleDevice' object has no attribute 'root' the first time anything CALLED it. It was found while measuring the probe's per-beat cost for the exit gate, not by any test. A second defect sat in the same function: the cheap half globbed FILENAMES for the bench prefix, and a file keeps its name after it is cleared, so it counted dead tickets as benches and disagreed with the expensive half exactly when a bench had just been lifted — the state that follows someone acting on this probe's own advice. Both are fixed by asking the store's own live() door. THE SHAPE IS THE TICKET'S OWN, ONE LEVEL UP: a watch that cannot run is a watch that is off, and this whole voyage is about a watch layer being switched off without anyone seeing. The emission gate proves a probe is berthed and armed; nothing proved it could RUN. Armed by hand is not wired, and the diagnostic is to call it.
